caption: The drawing depicts a single white ceramic bowl with a wide opening and a narrow base, positioned upright on a light, neutral background. The bowl features a decorative band encircling its upper outer surface. This band includes a pink stripe at the top, beneath which is a pattern consisting of alternating blue leaf-like shapes, green elements, and brownish-red vine-like tendrils with small dots, all set against a white background. Below this decorative band is a thin blue line that runs around the circumference of the bowl near the base. The bowl's interior is plain and rendered in shades of light gray and white to indicate depth and reflection. There are no other objects or elements in the composition, and the background remains empty and off-white.
title: Soup Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
